sentences.text: Shri Rohit Jain - Advocate for the appel  Shri Ramkripal Mishra - Advocate for res Shri Rohit Jain has raised two legal issues.
In this case, firstly whether owner for his own breach can be compensated under Chapter 11 of the Motor Vehicles Act.
Second, whether the claim under Section 163-A is available in relation to the owner and driver of the vehicle or it is available only in respect of the third party.
The third issue is whether the compensation could have been awarded to the extent of personal accident cover despite there being any breach of the policy.
Shri Ramkripal Mishra is not prepared with the matter.
He prays for fifteen days time to do the needful.
On his request, time is granted.
List this appeal after fifteen days.
